name: Red Hook Tigers
description: Red Hook Tigers was a street gang based in the Red Hook neighborhood of Brooklyn, New York, active during the 1950s greaser era. They were known rivals of the South Brooklyn Boys, clashing repeatedly in Prospect Park around 1950. The rivalry turned deadly when a South Brooklyn Boy killed a Red Hook Tiger during one of these fights; on December 6, 1950, the shooter was sentenced to 15 to 30 years, triggering a riot in the courtroom.
